description: Newest first: a Vlad account's claim, money added, gains out, withdrawals, moves, standing-order runs and its fund's trades (Lapo's), and its wallet's pay accounts' payments (with the key that signed), USDG in, withdrawals and key or owner changes. Each row has its time, transaction and one plain sentence. ref: an agentId, a wallet or a pay account. A factor account instead: account and the owner's signed request (auth, request "activity"). Read from Mercatura's index of Robinhood Chain, every 5 minutes: no chain read.

account.description: Instead of ref: a factor account, for its owner (with auth).

auth.description: With account: the owner's signed request for request "activity".

issued.description: The ISO 8601 UTC time in the signed text.

before.description: Optional: a previous answer's next, for older rows.

kinds.description: Optional, comma-separated: payments, in, out, trades, changes.

ref.description: An agentId (a whole number), a wallet, or a pay account (a 0x address).

since.description: Optional: only rows at or after this unix time (seconds).

name: activity
title: Activity: what an agent's money did
